name: Mountainous Republic of the Northern Caucasus (1918–1919)
description: Seven horizontal stripes alternating green and white, with a blue canton bearing seven gold five-pointed stars in an arc.
history: The Mountainous Republic, uniting the peoples of the North Caucasus, declared independence from Russia on 11 May 1918; the seven-star flag stood for its seven constituent peoples. It was overrun by Denikin's Volunteer Army in May 1919. The flag is used today by North Caucasian émigré and Circassian organisations.

features.symbolism: the seven peoples of the republic — Abkhaz, Adyghe, Chechens, Dagestanis, Ingush, Kabardians and Ossetians
